mapper.update: UPDATE reviews SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{reviewId}
UPDATE reviews SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{reviewId}
UPDATE reviews SET useful_count = useful_count + 1 WHERE id = #{reviewId}
UPDATE reviews SET useful_count = GREATEST(useful_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{reviewId}
UPDATE reviews SET like_count = #{count} WHERE id = #{reviewId}
UPDATE reviews SET useful_count = #{count} WHERE id = #{reviewId}
UPDATE reviews SET reply_count = reply_count + 1 WHERE id = #{reviewId}
UPDATE reviews SET reply_count = GREATEST(reply_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{reviewId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalReviews, AVG(overall_rating) as averageRating, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_recommended = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as recommendRate FROM reviews WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 'approved'

SELECT overall_rating as rating, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 'approved'), 2) as percentage FROM reviews WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 'approved' GROUP BY overall_rating ORDER BY overall_rating DESC

SELECT tag, COUNT(*) as count FROM ( SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(review_tags, CONCAT('$[', numbers.n, ']'))) as tag FROM reviews JOIN (SELECT 0 as n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4) numbers WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 'approved' AND JSON_LENGTH(review_tags) > numbers.n ) as tags WHERE tag IS NOT NULL AND tag != '' GROUP BY tag ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10
